subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are true about the Indian river system?

A. Mandovi and Juari are two important rivers of Goa.

B. Periyar is the largest river of Karnataka.

C. Vaitarna originates from the Trimbak hills in Nashik district of Maharashtra.
solution:
The answer is** A and C. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mandovi or Mahadayi **is also described as the lifeline of Goa. It originates from** bhimgad Karnatka** and travels to Goa. **(Hence statement A is correct) **
 
• The **Juari **is the largest river in Goa. It is a tidal river that originates at **Hemad Barshem** in the Western Ghats.
 
• The Mandovi river joins the Juari river at the** creek at Cabo Aguada forming the Mormugao Harbour.**
 
• **The Vaitarna river **originates from the **Trimbak hills in the Nashik district of Maharashtra,** it covers the **palghar and Nashik **districts of Maharashtra. **(Hence statement C is correct) **
 
• The left bank tributary of Vaitarna is **Tansa** and its right bank tributaries are **Pinjal, Dehraja, and Surya.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Periyar is the **Largest and longest river** in the Indian state, of **Kerala. (Hence statement B is incorrect) **
 
• It is also referred to as the** lifeline of Kerala.**
 
• It is one the most important **perennial river of Kerala **since it provides drinking water for several major towns of Kerala.
